summary: Connect mobile MEAL data to quality checks and operational dashboards. Explore practical pipelines and reporting workflows; view the course outline.
lede: MEAL data engineering connects programme data collection with operational reporting. For MEAL officers, data managers and IT support staff, the course covers mapping data flows from tools such as ODK and KoboToolbox, profiling records, setting quality checks and using basic SQL with PostgreSQL staging concepts. Participants also plan indicator integrations, routine refreshes, introductory REST API or file-exchange options, and dashboard requirements.
audienceIntro: This course suits practitioners who handle programme evidence directly or support the systems that move it from collection to reporting. It is designed for MEAL and IT colleagues who need a shared, practical approach to data pipelines and operational reporting.
audience: Programme Managers using dashboard trends to allocate
modules: Excel and BI Dashboards for MEAL
prerequisites: Bring familiarity with MEAL indicators, routine programme reporting and spreadsheet-based data handling. No prior data science or programming background is required. The course introduces SQL through guided examples; participants can complete the core pipeline mapping and design exercises without writing code.
